kpis.description_fr: Pool Equipment = chemicals + filtres + pompes + accessoires piscines. ~50 % du CA. Cycle remodel + maintenance.
kpis.description_en: Pool Equipment = chemicals + filters + pumps + pool accessories. ~50% of revenue. Remodel + maintenance cycle.

kpis.description_fr: New Pool = constructions neuves piscines. Soft cycle 2024 sur taux hypothécaires. Recovery dependant macro housing.
kpis.description_en: New Pool = new pool constructions. Soft 2024 cycle on mortgage rates. Recovery depends on housing macro.

kpis.description_fr: 60 % du CA = maintenance récurrent (chemicals, parts, services). Stabilité cycle. Acquisition piscines existantes croît base installée.
kpis.description_en: 60% of revenue = recurring maintenance (chemicals, parts, services). Cycle stability. Existing pool acquisitions grow installed base.

kpis.description_fr: ~445 sales centers (USA + Europe + Australie). Plus gros distributeur exclusif piscines monde. Densité maillage moat.
kpis.description_en: ~445 sales centers (USA + Europe + Australia). Largest exclusive pool distributor globally. Network density moat.

kpis.description_fr: Hot Tub & Spa ~10 % du CA. Diversification segment piscine. Cycle aligné mais marges sup.
kpis.description_en: Hot Tub & Spa ~10% of revenue. Pool segment diversification. Aligned cycle but higher margins.
